simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צוֹאָה (H6675) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צוֹאָה (tsôwʼâh) means excrement ; generally, dirt ; figuratively, pollution First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 18 27.

definitions.full: H6675. tsoah or tsoah(844b) צֹאָה noun feminine filth ; — absolute ׳צ Isa 28:8 (of drunkards' vomit, compare קִיא ); ׳צ figurative of iniquity, construct צֹאַת 4:4 , suffix צֹאָתוֺ Prov 30:12 ; specifically of human excrement ( = [ צֵאָה ]) suffix צֵאָתָם 2Kin 18:27 = Isa 36:12 . (both Qr; Kt חר(א)יהם , compare [ חֶרֶא ] p. 351 above).
